entries.title: Protostellar Cloud Collapse to Star Core
entries.description: A large, semi-transparent rotating gas sphere slowly contracts under gravity, with small colored gas particles spiraling inward, density color-coding, and a bright, pulsing core forming at the center as outer regions darken.
entries.seed: Protostellar Cloud Collapse to Star Core: A large, semi-transparent rotating gas sphere slowly contracts under gravity, with small colored gas particles spiraling inward, density color-coding, and a bright, pulsing core forming at the center as outer regions darken.

entries.title: Accretion Disk and Jet Formation
entries.description: A central glowing sphere is fed by a flat, rotating disk of small particles that spiral inward, while narrow, opposite jets of fast-moving particles shoot out along the rotation axis with fading trails and brightness tied to infall rate.

entries.title: Fragmenting Molecular Cloud into Multiple Stars
entries.description: A big translucent gas cloud gradually condenses into several denser clumps that detach, spin, and glow, each forming its own mini-rotating disk and central star, with color-coded temperature and faint particle bridges that break as they drift apart.

entries.title: Binary Star Formation from Collapsing Cloud
entries.description: A rotating elongated gas blob collapses into two bright spheres that orbit a common center, pulling in nearby particles from a shared disk, with each star’s accreted material shown by differently colored swirling trails.

entries.title: Supernova Core Collapse and Shock Wave
entries.description: A massive bright star sphere suddenly shrinks its core, then explodes into an expanding shell of colored particles, with a shock front ring that pushes ambient particles outward and leaves behind a tiny, extremely bright neutron star or black sphere.

entries.title: Black Hole Birth from Stellar Collapse
entries.description: A large star gradually brightens and pulses, then rapidly collapses into a small dark sphere with a glowing, warped halo, as nearby test particles and a loose gas cloud spiral into an accretion ring and disappear at the event horizon.

entries.title: Nebula Expansion and New Star Seeds
entries.description: A compact glowing sphere erupts into a colorful, expanding, semi-transparent nebula with embedded small dense knots that slowly brighten and contract, showing stars “born” within the drifting cloud with soft radial light.

entries.title: Star Cluster Birth from Turbulent Cloud
entries.description: A big rotating, clumpy gas volume contains dozens of dense regions that condense into small stars, which then begin to orbit in a loose cluster, leaving gas behind that gradually disperses as color-faded particles.

entries.title: Lifecycle Timeline: From Protostar to White Dwarf
entries.description: Along a straight or curved 3D path, several spheres represent the same star at stages (cloud core, protostar, main sequence, red giant, planetary nebula, white dwarf), with arrows or thin glowing connectors, each stage animated with its own pulsing, shrinking, or expanding motion.
